name: Harvey’s circulation of the blood
description: William Harvey published an account in which the heart pumps blood in continual circulation around the body.

date.label: 1628 CE
date.basis: Date reported by the cited institutional source.

events.statement: William Harvey published an account in which the heart pumps blood in continual circulation around the body.

evidence.supports: The Royal College of Physicians identifies Harvey’s De motu cordis publication in 1628 and describes its account of blood circulation.
The museum states that the 1628 edition was published in Frankfurt.

events.caveats: The museum is a retrospective summary; related earlier work, specific theoretical antecedents and transmission remain to be researched.
events.place_note: Published in Frankfurt; the work was developed in an English medical context.
